text: User correction 2026-09-12 supersedes earlier ownership framing: Eidolon is an early-stage idea and is not a current focus. This P3 proposal imposes no architecture, module retirement, migration or dependency requirement on ScalaFIM. Keep it dormant unless concrete native correctness/performance/API needs or an explicitly adopted consumer justify reopening implementation. Core ScalaFIM work and PHRF proceed independently. Historical ADR/RFE text is retained as proposal history, not binding authority.
